trace_note: Both assignments come from one split call, so the recorded trace counts one model-decided step where the diagram plays two: one model output selected both transitions.
title: Lead agent and workers
sub: A lead splits the question into sub-questions no code could predict in advance, each worker answers from its own document, and the lead combines the results with citations.

steps.d:
"What is the DW-300's annual energy use, and how
much does the DR-520's drive belt cost?"

steps.h: The lead reads the question and assigns worker 1
steps.d: → worker 1: "What is the DW-300's annual energy use?"

steps.h: The same call also assigns worker 2
steps.d: → worker 2: "What does the DR-520's drive belt cost?"

steps.h: Worker 1 answers from its own document
Worker 2 answers from a different document
The lead combines both, keeping their citations
steps.d:
"The DW-300 uses about 260 kWh per year
[dw300-manual#3]. The DR-520's drive belt (HLV-6601)
costs $9.75 [parts-list#3]."
